description: ol-style-name-case (issue #854): the Heritage assignment head `make` written non-lowercase. `make` lowers onto the same `Assign` node as Core's `set … to`, and the casing check used to be gated on a hand-written table of node KINDS that never listed `Assign` — so `MAKE` was unreachable by the lint entirely. The head is now read as the word the statement's own span begins with, which reaches every keyword-headed statement at once. `params.name` carries the literal source spelling.
